I assumed a photorealistic reference-sheet look, since the working directory is empty and there's no series style guide to follow. The boy is in an ordinary Yerevan courtyard outfit for an everyday summer day, not school uniform. If your series is illustrated, swap the style line at the start of the prompt and keep the clothing details.

**Period choices built into the prompt:**
- **No red Pioneer scarf.** Pioneer membership ended at 14, so a 15-year-old wouldn't wear one. He's Komsomol age, but in summer he wouldn't wear the pin.
- **Long trousers, not shorts.** In 1984 Armenia, shorts were mostly for younger kids. A 15-year-old usually wore light trousers, often a bit short from a growth spurt.
- **No visible brands.** That means unbranded Soviet canvas sneakers (*kedy*), Soviet-made clothes, no Western logos and no denim. Real Western jeans were a rare black-market item, so they'd suggest the wrong social status.
- **Small realistic touches:** a hand-me-down fit, a summer tan, scuffed shoes and a plain cheap wristwatch.

## FINAL

**Prompt:**
```
Full-body character reference photo of a 15-year-old Armenian boy in Soviet Yerevan, summer 1984. Slim, lanky teenage build, tanned olive skin, thick dark brown hair cut short at the back and sides, slightly longer on top with a natural side part, dark eyes, thick eyebrows. Neutral standing pose, facing camera, arms relaxed at sides, feet slightly apart, calm neutral expression.

Outfit, period-accurate Soviet 1984: short-sleeve cotton button-up shirt in a faded light-blue and white small check pattern, pointed 1970s-style collar worn open, top button undone, sleeves slightly wide, shirt tucked in; straight-cut dark brown (or navy) cotton-polyester trousers, slightly short at the ankle as if outgrown, high waist, held by a thin brown leather belt with a plain metal buckle; white socks; worn white-and-blue Soviet canvas sneakers (kedy) with rubber toe caps, scuffed, no logos; simple Soviet wristwatch with a cheap metal strap on the left wrist. Clothes slightly faded, softly wrinkled, hand-me-down fit, modest and clean.

Plain light-grey seamless studio background, even soft daylight lighting, no harsh shadows, whole figure in frame from head to shoes with a small margin, eye-level camera, 50mm lens, sharp focus, realistic fabric texture, subtle 1980s Soviet color film tone (ORWO/Svema), natural skin, documentary realism, costume design reference sheet.
```

red Pioneer scarf, neckerchief, school uniform, Komsomol badge, brand logos, Nike, Adidas, Levi's, denim jeans, graphic t-shirt, printed text, hoodie, cargo shorts, modern sneakers, baseball cap, modern fade haircut, undercut, earbuds, phone, backpack, tattoos, jewelry, skinny jeans, slim-fit modern tailoring, oversized streetwear, cropped body, cut-off feet, dynamic pose, smiling, cartoon, anime, illustration, extra limbs, deformed hands, blurry, watermark, text

**Settings:**
- Aspect ratio: **2:3** (or 9:16 to fit the full body more easily)
- Midjourney: `--ar 2:3 --style raw --v 7 --s 100`, with the negatives passed via `--no …` (short list: `--no logos, denim, red scarf, modern sneakers, text`)
- SD/SDXL/Flux: 30–40 steps, CFG 5–7 (Flux guidance ~3.5), 832×1248, fixed seed for consistency
- Character consistency: once you have a good result, reuse it as a character/image reference (`--cref` / IP-Adapter) and keep the same seed
